text: Power that keeps coming while you are away. Seat a crystal inside, surround it with totems of different voices, and it hums out Pulse on its own. It stores up to **2,500 Pulse**, and breaking it loses what is stored.

pages.title: Getting it running
text: Right-click the Resonator with an **Echo Shard** (from [Echo Shatter](echo_shatter)). The crystal sits inside as a catalyst and is slowly spent by the Pulse it makes, so a hard-working Resonator needs it replaced. Crouch and right-click it with an empty hand to lift out what is left of the crystal; it keeps its wear. Lift the old crystal out before seating a better one. Hoppers cannot feed it.
Then give it at least **two different voices** within 8 blocks, such as an Earth and a Fire totem. It counts voices, not blocks: two Earth totems are still one voice.
A shard and two voices make **8 Pulse a second**. Voices multiply rather than add: each one you bring is worth more than the last, so the whole ring is worth far more than the sum of its totems.

steps.caption: Place the Resonator where its totems will have room around it.
Right-click it with an Echo Shard to seat the catalyst.
Add a Fire totem, a second voice. The Resonator starts to hum: 8 Pulse a second.
A third voice, Water, lifts it to 15 Pulse a second. Every new voice is worth more than the last.

pages.title: Stronger crystals
text: Each second the Resonator makes **voices × (voices + 2)** Pulse, times its crystal: **×1** for an Echo Shard, **×1.5** Attuned, **×2** Bound, **×3** for a Resonant Core. So six voices make 48, 72, 96 or 144 a second.
- **Echo Shard**: stone in Echo Shatter, with Earth.
- **Attuned Echo**: shards in Echo Attune, with Fire.
- **Bound Echo**: attuned echoes in Echo Bind, with Water.
- **Resonant Core**: Manifested Ingots in Echo Manifest, with Spirit.
Six voices need the [Voice Ring](voice_ring) layout: a loose heap counts at most five voices, Kinship Totems included.
To burn these crystals beside reagents and water, with all six voices in a star, build a [Ley Heart](ley_heart).

pages.title: When it stays dark
text: Only **Answered** totems count; a quiet one has to be woken first (see [Keeping](keeping)). Kinship Totems add their tribes as extra voices, but the Resonator still needs one Answered Resonance Totem of its own. A steady redstone signal pauses it.

A crystal crumbles once it has made its share: about **20,000 Pulse** for an Echo Shard, **60,000** for an Attuned Echo, **150,000** for a Bound Echo and **400,000** for a Resonant Core. A full Resonator makes nothing, and its crystal rests until something spends.
Each [rank](machine_ranks) of the Resonator itself adds **15% Pulse a second**.
